title: HF4745 (2025-2026 Regular): Firearms prohibited in buildings owned by or under the control of state or local governments, and criminal penalties provided.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2026-03-26; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2026/0/HF/4745/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version, 2026-03-26. No votes recorded. Exceptions in (b) for peace officers, military on duty, and people with written permission from the building's controller.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1i): (a) A person who possesses a firearm within a building owned by the state or a local government, or within a portion of a building leased or otherwise controlled by the state or a local government, and used for the purpose of government administration, is guilty of a felony and may be sentenced to imprisonment for not more than five years or to payment of a fine of not more than $10,000, or both.
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1i): (c) This subdivision does not apply to locations described in subdivision 1d or 1g.
